issue: Point names padded with variable internal spacing (Plant B compressor reports, fixed-width format)
action: Collapsed repeated whitespace so the same point has one name across all files

issue: Inconsistent / truncated unit strings ('Deg. F.' vs 'Deg. F', 'PSIG' vs 'Psig', 'Setpoin' used for temperature and setpoint rows)
action: Mapped all units to a standard set: degF, psig, psid, pct_level, pct_FLA, pct_open, cycles (all 'Setpoin' rows are temperatures)

issue: Plant B 2026-06-05 files (Area Temps, Compressor 1) carry data for 2026-06-04; file name and page header say 06-05
action: Used the date inside the report body as the true data date (06-04); added date_corrected flag

issue: Truncated point name 'V2 Liqui' (Plant A)
action: Kept original in 'point'; added readable 'point_label' (V2 Liquid Level)

issue: Setpoint ('SPT ...') names are truncated and do not match the measured point name (e.g. 'SPT UC-8 Fin. Goods Co')
action: Added 'measures_point' linking each setpoint row to its measured point (38 of 38 setpoint points linked; unlinked: [])

issue: Points exported twice in the same report (Plant A UC-3/4 Pre-Weigh & its SPT; Plant B V-2 Intercooler Pres.) - all 474 pairs byte-identical
action: Dropped the second copy

issue: Disconnected sensors: hourly value 459.6 (minus sign dropped) with summary Low/High/Avg = -459.67 (absolute zero). Plant B UC-7 Boxing And Dock (every day) and UC-4 Filling Room (11 days)
action: value_clean set to blank; quality_flag='sensor_disconnected'; raw value kept in value_raw

issue: Plant A 2026-09-15: hours 14-23 are literal 0.0 for every point in both reports (export/controller cut-off written as zeros); the summary Average is dragged down (e.g. UC-1 Engine Room avg 41.7 F)
action: Hours 14-23 blank in value_clean; summary Average blanked in daily file; quality_flag='export_truncated_zero_fill'

issue: Drifting / failed room-temperature sensor: Plant C Back Dock Temp reads 130-283 F on 2026-05-20..06-04 and 2026-09-03..09-12 (a dock cannot be 280 F)
action: Hourly values >130 F on room-temperature points blanked in value_clean; quality_flag='implausible_value'. Lower drifting values (below 130 F) are NOT removed - see notes

issue: Negative vessel liquid level (Plant A V2 Liqui = -18.8 % on one hour)
action: Blanked in value_clean; quality_flag='implausible_value'

issue: Stuck sensor: Plant A UC-25 reads one constant value for all 24 hours on 2026-08-04..08-10 (work order WO-26500: 'temperature display not changing', fixed 8/11 14:00)
action: value_clean blank; quality_flag='stuck_value' (only zero-variance TEMPERATURE points are flagged; idle compressors and transfer counters legitimately flat-line and are kept)

issue: Plant B setpoint channels read 0.0 on every hour in all Apr-May/Jul-Sep exports and June 1-2 (setpoints not exported); real setpoints only appear from 2026-06-10 onward
action: value_clean blank; quality_flag='setpoint_unavailable' (learn normal from history instead)

issue: Missing days / report groups in Apr-May & Jul-Sep: Plant A no files on 05-09 and 09-21 (Valve Group also missing 05-14, 08-06); Plant B no files on 08-20 (compressor reports also missing on 04-22, 07-16, 08-27, 09-10); Plant C no file on 6 days (04-18, 05-03, 07-12, 08-02, 08-30, 09-27)
action: NOT filled or imputed; listed explicitly in *_coverage.csv so gaps are visible to modeling code

issue: Page-break headers repeat inside each report; fixed-width layout differs between folder 01 (normalized) and folder 04 (padded)
action: Parsed both layouts into one schema; 30,284 raw point-blocks parsed with 0 unparsed lines

issue: 5 monthly files (Apr, May, Jul, Aug, Sep; no June)
action: Merged into one file sorted by open time

issue: 'closed' stamped 23:59 when the door stayed open past midnight, so closed-opened disagrees with open_minutes
action: Recomputed closed = opened + open_minutes (spills into next day); original kept in closed_raw; flag closed_clipped_at_midnight

issue: 15 files (5 months x 3 stations in rows) with no plant key, only a station string
action: Merged; added 'plant' column so it joins directly to controller/ops tables

issue: End time '24:00' is not a valid clock time (106 rows); holiday rows have blank start/end
action: Added start_ts/end_ts as real timestamps (24:00 -> 00:00 next day) and duration_hours; original start/end kept; added is_holiday

issue: Placeholder text '(not acknowledged)' stored in the acknowledged_by column
action: Blanked and added boolean 'acknowledged'; added duration_min and numeric alarm_threshold_F / alarm_offset_over_setpoint_F parsed from the alarm text

issue: 'reading' mixes degF, psig, psid and % with the unit only implied by 'instrument'
action: Added explicit 'unit' column (same unit vocabulary as the controller CSVs)

issue: Blank reefer setpoint / product temperature on all Dry ingredients and Packaging receipts
action: Left blank (not missing: ambient goods are not temperature-checked); added 'temp_applicable' so models do not treat these as missing data

issue: Location recorded as 'various' for 18 of 47 events even though each detector has one fixed location in the asset register
action: Filled 'location' from asset_register via detector_id; original text kept in location_logged

issue: Alarm setpoints stored as one text string ('25 / 150 ppm')
action: Split into numeric warning_ppm and alarm_ppm

issue: Checked: no duplicate keys, no orphan asset_ids, no bad dates, completed/status consistent, no non-numeric values
action: No changes needed; copied through unchanged (blank completed/parts/notes cells are genuine 'not applicable')
